judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec file, and three failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`. It never actually implemented the feature in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or added `ajv` to `package.json`, meaning the added tests will fail immediately because `ToolRegistry.execute` still invokes the executor without validation. Furthermore, most of the required unit tests, the `registry.test.ts` file, the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and all documentation/changelog updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) are completely missing.
